reason: Changes a core SQL operator (`IN`) in `pkg/expression`, with downstream planner/ranger and integration test updates. Even though the patch is small, deduplicating `IN` arguments can affect expression semantics and optimizer/range behavior in subtle ways (for example NULL handling, type coercion/collation, nondeterministic expressions, and equality semantics), so it is central and risky enough for a focused Blocker/High review.
